name: ascet_code_search
description: Search saved ASCET C/ESDL, State/Transition code and original BDE fields. No operation argument. query arrays are independent searches sharing one limit, not AND. Prefer identifier mode for variables, known in.component/in.diagram refs and group_by:object for BDE. Text results contain original-line snippets (default context 10 each side); BDE hits merge fields per placed object and preview direct connections. Read hit/endpoint refs locally; outer Diagram refs read whole Diagrams. in.member selects the entire owning Diagram, including shared diagram_methods. limit defaults to 50, max 200; counts remain complete. Continue with only cursor while has_more. partial/issues cannot prove absence. Generated code, unsaved buffers, Dataset values, Formula definitions and transitive implementations are excluded.

query.description: A string, one {text,mode,...} object, or 1-64 independent terms; usually batch 2-6 relevant clues. Strings inherit top-level pattern options; objects override only supplied options. An array does not require all terms in the same Method, Process or other code result. This is not a Component/Method name catalog or semantic search.

mode.description: Use identifier for a complete variable/parameter name, text for literal code or a substring, and regex only for a pattern (ECMAScript Unicode, without / delimiters). No glob or typo-fuzzy mode; * is literal in text mode. Batch default; each query object may override it.

case_sensitive.description: Use true when exact symbol spelling is known. Defaults to false; query objects may override it. Metadata filters remain case-sensitive.

multiline.description: Allow matches across lines. When omitted, actual newlines in the query or dotall:true enable it; otherwise false. Batch entries inherit an explicit top-level value unless overridden.

dotall.description: Regex only: allow . to match newlines. Implies multiline unless multiline is explicitly set. Batch default; each query object may override it.

context.description: Lines before and after matches; defaults to 10 on each side. Use 20 for a wider window, {before,after} for different counts, or 0 for no surrounding lines. In the object form an omitted side is 0. Each result normally retains at most 40 context lines; page byte budgets may shorten it further. Inspect omitted_lines/truncation and use ascet_code_read for the complete implementation.

in.description: Restrict by known exact metadata: values are case-sensitive, lists mean OR within a field, fields mean AND. Shared by all queries. Omit unknown scope instead of inventing identities.

component.description: A known 29-character ASCET Component OID, or a temporary result ref actually returned in this session. A ref selects the entire owning Component and pins its Database. It is not an Element Reference. Component names and model paths are not accepted.

oneOf.description: Exact saved Method/Process name or full State/Transition path. Filters the selected code while query searches content. Use ascet_code_find for independent name lookup.

items.description: Exact saved Method/Process name or full State/Transition path. Filters the selected code while query searches content. Use ascet_code_find for independent name lookup.

member.description: Method/Process name, State/Transition path, or Diagram name. A graphical Method selects its entire owning Diagram.

member_id.description: Exact saved identity for a Method, Process, State or Transition from known model metadata. Distinguishes objects with the same displayed name; do not guess IDs.

kind.description: Exact code kind(s). Init may be method, process or diagram. State Entry/Static/Exit Actions and Transition Condition/Action/Trigger contain code; *_binding results describe stored Method bindings without fetching their implementations.

variant.description: Exact Variant(s) from known metadata, such as ASDL. Omission includes supported Variants; it does not select one specific language/version.

implementation.description: Exact Implementation OID(s); the empty string selects the base Implementation. Omit to include supported Implementations. Do not pass a displayed name.

diagram.description: Exact whole Diagram refs from this session, or source OIDs paired with exactly one explicit in.component. Cross-Component selection uses refs and preserves each Component/Diagram pair. Does not accept names or object refs. Pins Database and ASCET process; scope reads fresh content.

visibility.description: Owning Diagram membership in Public/Private Specifications; omit for both. Applies to BDE and owned State/Transition code, not text Method access or model folder names. Combines by intersection with other scope fields.

limit.description: Shared page budget across all queries, default 50, maximum 200. Counts occurrences normally; with group_by:object, counts BDE objects plus text occurrences. Bytes may further reduce the page.

database.description: Optional expected database path used as a safety precondition, not a command to open or switch databases. Omit to search the current database.

debug.description: Include database, timing and coverage diagnostics for troubleshooting. Leave false for ordinary code exploration.

group_by.description: object groups BDE matches by graphical identity before pagination. Text stays occurrence-based. Same-named objects remain separate. Omit for the existing snippets/occurrence contract.

cursor.description: Use the exact next_cursor from a previous response in this same session, with no other fields. Continues its immutable snapshot; an expired/evicted cursor requires a new search.

text.description: Code search term in the effective mode. Actual newlines enable multiline by default.

id.description: Optional caller label echoed in this query's results.

mode.description: Overrides top-level mode. Without either, use text. Regex uses ECMAScript Unicode without / delimiters.

case_sensitive.description: Overrides top-level case_sensitive; false when neither is supplied.

multiline.description: Overrides top-level multiline. When neither is supplied, actual newlines or effective dotall:true enable cross-line matching.

dotall.description: Regex only: overrides top-level dotall; false when neither is supplied. Dot spans newlines when true; implies multiline unless explicitly set.
